description: Scheduled dates in AI, soonest first: regulation and standards dates (each with its official source), model retirements and deprecations (Model Tracker), price changes. Each date has its precision (exact, month, quarter, not_before, earliest, tentative) and dateText as the source states it. Filter by kinds, jurisdictions (EU, US, US-CA, UK, CN, ...), entity (our entity slug), from_date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today) and days (default 365).
name: list_deadlines

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the first day of a month or quarter for those precisions

dateText.description: the date as the source states it; show this, not date alone

setBy.description: the jurisdiction, or the lab for a model date

source.description: {url, title, verifiedAt}: the official page that states the date

url.description: our page for the item (the model page for tracker dates)

title: Dates and deadlines
